name: Sword of Life Stealing
description: A longsword of blackened steel that is warm after every fight.
body:
## What it does

Any sword can carry this hunger; this one is a longsword. When you roll a 20 against a creature that is neither a construct nor undead, the blade drinks from it, and you gain as many temporary hit points as the extra damage it deals.

damage.note: on a 20 against a creature that is not a construct or undead; you gain that many temporary hit points
